spine: 1. Sander Bos 幫自己的 Lua 引擎 grug-for-lua 跑 benchmark，發現同一段沒有改過的迴圈，固定時間內某次跑完 60 億次迭代，某次只有 3 億次，相差 20 倍。
2. 第一個猜測：程式碼裡唯一可疑的地方是包在 pcall 裡的 unpack——LuaJIT NYI wiki 把它列為 stitch 類，他一開始以為是 stitch 本身要臨時掉回直譯器才變慢。
3. 用 luajit -jv 追蹤後推翻了這個猜測：unpack 從頭到尾沒有出現在慢的那次 trace log 裡，問題顯然不在 unpack 執行的當下。
4. 縮小成 MRE（empty_fn + run_unpack，pcall 包 unpack({})）後，同一份程式兩次執行分別跑出 0.050325 秒與 0.725689 秒；兩次 trace log 只差在收尾：快版編譯成一條 loop，慢版收在 blacklisted。
5. 機制：unpack 觸發 stitch，讓 recorder 從下一條 bytecode 重新開始錄成一條新 root trace，這條新 trace 不記得自己是從 pcall 的 FRAME_PCALL 裡進來的，返回時 recording 中止，丟出 NYI: return to lower frame。
6. 重試次數用盡後，含 pcall 呼叫的那段 bytecode 整個被黑名單；empty_fn 自己沒碰過 pcall 或 unpack，卻因為被同一段熱迴圈呼叫而連帶掉回直譯器，快慢版最終跑出哪一種，取決於 benchmark loop 開始前已經跑掉多少次 stitch attempt，是 JIT 內部啟發式決定的。

7. 修法分兩層：先用 get_pcall_wrapper 產生的特化 wrapper 取代 unpack（commit db94c5a）；再向 OpenResty 的 luajit2 fork 送出 PR #269，新增 recff_unpack 教 trace recorder 直接編譯 unpack，但因為多數人用的是內嵌、極少升級的 LuaJIT，wrapper 仍是大多數人實際要用的解法。

perspective.mechanism: LuaJIT 的 trace stitching 遇到 unpack 這類 stitch-NYI 時，會讓 recorder 從下一條 bytecode 重新開始錄成一條新的 root trace；這條新 trace 不記得自己是從 pcall 建立的 FRAME_PCALL 裡進來的，導致返回時 recording 中止，重試用盡後整段 bytecode 被黑名單，連沒碰過 pcall/unpack 的呼叫者都被牽連。
perspective.tradeoff: 繞開 unpack 用手寫 wrapper 可以馬上解決問題，但只是治標；真正教會編譯器處理 unpack（recff_unpack）只在 OpenResty 的 luajit2 fork 有效，絕大多數內嵌 LuaJIT 又不常升級的環境還是得繼續用 wrapper。
perspective.reader_use: 任何用 tracing JIT（LuaJIT、V8、PyPy 等）的工程師，遇到效能異常時應該先看 -jv/-jdump 這類 trace log 裡有沒有 NYI 或 blacklisted，而不是單靠直覺猜哪一行程式碼寫壞；也可以把這類檢查接進 CI，提早攔下會被黑名單的熱路徑。

perspective.mechanism: lobste.rs 是聚合站，本身不產生技術內容，只是把 streamhpc 的原文貼上首頁並標上 lua、performance 兩個 tag。
perspective.tradeoff: 沒有獨立技術內容，不能當作第二個獨立來源使用，只能拿來確認這篇文章當天在社群有被轉貼與討論的興趣。
perspective.reader_use: 讀者可以從這裡的標籤（lua、performance）快速判斷這篇文章屬於哪個技術社群圈子，但技術細節仍須回原文查證。

notes.quote: I ran into this while benchmarking grug-for-lua, my Lua implementation of the grug modding language.
notes.interpretation: 建立背景與作者身分，說明這個 bug 是在作者自己真實專案的 benchmark 中發現的，不是刻意構造的合成測試。

notes.quote: in some benchmark runs my code performs 6 billion iterations, and in other benchmark runs it can perform as little as 300 million iterations, a 20× difference
notes.interpretation: 全文的核心觀察（puzzle），開篇 hook 與 hero chart 的資料來源；固定時間視窗內的迭代數變化 20 倍。

notes.quote: My initial assumption was that the stitch itself caused the slowdown by temporarily dropping back to the interpreter.
notes.interpretation: 第一個猜測（candidate 1）：作者一開始以為 stitch 本身臨時掉回直譯器的動作有代價，稍後被 -jv 輸出推翻。

notes.quote: But when I profiled the benchmark with LuaJIT 2.1.1774896198 using -jv, unpack never appeared in the trace log at all.
notes.interpretation: 推翻猜測一的直接證據：unpack 完全沒有出現在慢的那次 trace log 裡，同時給出使用的 LuaJIT 版本號。

notes.quote: To isolate it, I wrote an MRE (minimal reproducible example):
notes.interpretation: 敘事轉折句，從真實專案的 benchmark 轉進最小可重現案例（MRE）的建構。

notes.quote:
local function empty_fn() end

local function run_unpack()
    pcall(empty_fn, unpack({}))
end

for _ = 1, 80000 do
    run_unpack()
end

local start = os.clock()

for _ = 1, 100000000 do
    empty_fn()
end

print(os.clock() - start)
notes.interpretation: MRE 完整原始碼，逐字用於文中程式碼區塊；empty_fn 完全沒有碰過 pcall/unpack，是被連累的對象。

notes.quote:
[TRACE   1 pcall_mre.lua:12 return]
[TRACE --- pcall_mre.lua:2 -- NYI: return to lower frame]
[TRACE   2 pcall_mre.lua:4 return]
[TRACE   3 pcall_mre.lua:22 loop]
0.050325
notes.interpretation: 快版執行的完整 trace log 與計時輸出；收尾在編譯成功的 loop trace，widget『before-after-slider』的 before 面板依據。

notes.quote:
[TRACE   1 pcall_mre.lua:12 return]
[TRACE --- pcall_mre.lua:2 -- NYI: return to lower frame]
[TRACE   2 pcall_mre.lua:4 return]
[TRACE --- pcall_mre.lua:22 -- blacklisted at pcall_mre.lua:2]
0.725689
notes.interpretation: 慢版執行的完整 trace log 與計時輸出；收尾在 blacklisted，widget『before-after-slider』的 after 面板依據，也是 0.725689/0.050325 換算 14 倍多落差的來源數字。

notes.quote: Because trace stitching resumes recording as a fresh root trace, the new trace has no record of entering the FRAME_PCALL, so recording aborts with exactly the error shown above: "NYI: return to lower frame".
notes.interpretation: 機制解釋的核心句：新錄製的 root trace 遺失 FRAME_PCALL 上下文，導致返回時 recording 中止，丟出對應錯誤訊息。

notes.quote: The key observation is that unpack never appears in the trace log. Instead, the recorder "forgets" that execution is inside a pcall, resuming recording as if that pcall had never happened. The failure doesn't happen at unpack itself; it happens later, when execution returns through that pcall.
notes.interpretation: 補強機制解釋：強調失敗發生在『返回』pcall 的時候，而不是 unpack 執行的當下——文中『log 裡沒有出現的東西才是線索』段落的依據。

notes.quote: pcall was never the problem here; it's fully traceable by LuaJIT. Only unpack triggers the stitch, which is why...
notes.interpretation: 澄清 pcall 本身完全可被 LuaJIT 追蹤、不是問題根源；真正觸發 stitch 的是 pcall 呼叫裡的 unpack。

notes.quote: Instead of failing immediately, LuaJIT performs a _stitch_, which lets it resume trace recording after the NYI instruction executes.
notes.interpretation: stitch 機制的定義：遇到 NYI 指令時不直接放棄整條 trace，而是讓那條指令執行完後恢復錄製。

notes.quote: [TRACE --- pcall_mre.lua:2 -- NYI: return to lower frame]
notes.interpretation: 逐行的 trace log 錯誤訊息，文中直接以「」引用「NYI: return to lower frame」字面訊息的依據，也是 tab-switcher widget 第 3 階段的依據。

notes.quote: Whether empty_fn ends up blacklisted depends on how many stitch attempts through the pcall complete before the benchmark loop begins, an outcome governed by the JIT's internal heuristics rather than anything in the code.
notes.interpretation: 解釋快慢版結果為何不可預測：由 JIT 內部啟發式演算法決定，不是程式碼本身決定的。

notes.quote:
The fix in db94c5a removes the final unpack() call and replaces it with generated wrapper functions:

local loader = loadstring or load

local pcall_wrappers = {}

local function get_pcall_wrapper(arg_count)
    if pcall_wrappers[arg_count] then
        return pcall_wrappers[arg_count]
    end

    local arg_list = {}
    for i = 1, arg_count do
        arg_list[i] = "args[" .. i .. "]"
    end

    local args_str = #arg_list > 0 and (", " .. table.concat(arg_list, ", ")) or ""
    local code = string.format("return function(fn, args) return pcall(fn%s) end", args_str)

    local wrapper = loader(code)()
    pcall_wrappers[arg_count] = wrapper
    return wrapper
end

Instead of forwarding arguments through unpack, each arity gets a specialized wrapper that indexes the args table directly.
notes.interpretation: 修法一（wrapper）的完整程式碼與說明，含 commit hash db94c5a（完整 hash db94c5ab3438f17b9b7191d4b72250215687440c）。

notes.quote: I named my pull request perf: get unpack() out of the NYI list, which targets luajit2, OpenResty's fork of LuaJIT, rather than upstream LuaJIT. [targets luajit2](https://github.com/openresty/luajit2/pull/269)
notes.interpretation: 修法二（上游 PR）：PR 標題與目標 repo，PR URL 為 https://github.com/openresty/luajit2/pull/269（PR #269）。

notes.quote: Here's the new, gnarly recff_unpack function the PR adds, which teaches the trace recorder to compile unpack directly instead of falling back to a stitch
notes.interpretation: recff_unpack 函式的介紹句：直接教 trace recorder 編譯 unpack，不必再靠 stitch 繞路。

notes.quote: Writing 30 tests confirming recff_unpack no longer stitches, throws NYIs, or gets blacklisted... surfaced 2 more edge cases the initial 30 tests missed. unimut systematically mutates the function's logic and checks whether the test suite still catches each change, surfacing gaps that plain line and branch coverage can't.
notes.interpretation: mutation testing（unimut）補強測試涵蓋率的例子：30 個手寫測試之外，mutation testing 又多找出 2 個邊界情況。

notes.quote: Even once this is merged, the get_pcall_wrapper workaround from earlier in this post isn't going anywhere. Almost nobody uses OpenResty's luajit2 fork specifically, and plenty of programs that do embed some LuaJIT never update the version they ship.
notes.interpretation: 作者對 PR 實際影響範圍的坦承評估：幾乎沒人專門用 luajit2 fork，多數內嵌 LuaJIT 的專案不常升級，wrapper 仍是多數人實際解法。

notes.quote:
local start = os.clock()

for _ = 1, 100000000 do
    local function nested() end
    nested()
end

print(os.clock() - start)

[TRACE --- closure_mre.lua:3 -- NYI: bytecode FNEW   at closure_mre.lua:4]

resulting in a 60× slowdown compared to the optimized version.
notes.interpretation: 第二個 NYI 案例（closure/FNEW，硬 NYI、不會 stitch）的原始碼、trace log 與效能落差數字，用於文中對照表格。

notes.quote: The broader danger of tracing JITs is that performance bugs don't always show up where you'd expect.
notes.interpretation: 全文的方法論主旨，對應 closer 與文末討論 tracing JIT 通用風險的段落。

notes.quote: Written by Sander Bos on 5 August 2026
notes.interpretation: 作者與發布日期。

notes.quote: title: The LuaJIT NYI That Silently Poisoned an Unrelated Hot Loop; submitter: Snektron; tags: lua, performance
notes.interpretation: 確認這是同一篇文章在 lobste.rs 上的分享，證實這是同日話題而非單一來源孤例；不作為獨立技術內容引用（echo，非 corroborated）。

notes.quote: If you want to inspect traces like this manually, luajit.me is a fantastic tool that is similar to Compiler Explorer. It is often much nicer than passing -jdump locally.
notes.interpretation: 診斷工具段落：luajit.me 可把 trace 輸出跟原始碼並排對照、NYI 標紅；luajit -jdump 是本機替代方案但較不順手。

notes.quote:
I configure my CI's build.yml to run benchmarks under luajit -jv. It lets the build fail if any NYI other than the known-sporadic return to lower frame case shows up in the trace log, or if any blacklisted line shows up.

CLEANED_LOG=$(sed '/NYI: return to lower frame/d' luajit.log)

if echo "$CLEANED_LOG" | grep -q 'NYI'; then
    echo "ERROR: Unexpected NYI detected in LuaJIT trace output" >&2
    echo "$CLEANED_LOG" | grep 'NYI' >&2
    exit 1
fi

if echo "$CLEANED_LOG" | grep -q 'blacklisted'; then
    echo "ERROR: Blacklisted function detected in LuaJIT trace output" >&2
    echo "$CLEANED_LOG" | grep 'blacklisted' >&2
    exit 1
fi
notes.interpretation: CI 整合段落：把 luajit -jv 輸出接進 build.yml，過濾掉已知的『NYI: return to lower frame』行後，抓到 NYI 或 blacklisted 就讓 build 失敗；文中 CI 段落與 shell 程式碼區塊的逐字依據。

notes.quote: Guard the length, since it wasn't given as a constant
notes.interpretation: recff_unpack 程式碼裡的原始註解，用於文中說明其陣列長度防呆邏輯；周邊敘述（非 table 引數擋下、start/end 索引可能非常數、allocation sinking）綜合自同一段程式碼與其上下文描述。

notes.quote:
function Entity:_run_game_fn(name, ...)
    local game_fn = self.file.game_fns[name]

    local ok, result = pcall(game_fn, self.state, ...)
end

It was called like so:

    self:_run_game_fn(call_expr.fn_name, unpack(args))
notes.interpretation: grug-for-lua 觸發路徑的實際程式碼：方法本身收一個 vararg 後直接轉手給 pcall，unpack(args) 出現在呼叫端而不是方法內部。開場段落描述這段程式碼的逐字依據。

notes.quote: In theory, LuaJIT could optimize the allocation away, much as it already does for tables using [its Allocation Sinking optimization](https://github.com/tarantool/tarantool/wiki/LuaJIT-Allocation-Sinking-Optimization).
notes.interpretation: Allocation Sinking 在原文只出現這一次，且位於後段 closure/FNEW 討論，主題是「閉包配置理論上有沒有可能被最佳化掉」，而不是 recff_unpack；原句自帶 in theory / could 的假設語氣，引用時必須保留。

notes.quote: Unlike unpack, FNEW (function new) is a hard NYI rather than a stitched one. As soon as the recorder reaches it, recording aborts outright. The NYI wiki correspondingly lists its Compiled? status as no. There's no race to win or lose here; the loop is simply stuck in the interpreter every time.
notes.interpretation: 原文對 FNEW 為何是硬 NYI 的全部說明：只講到 recorder 一碰到就中止錄製、wiki 的 Compiled? 欄位為 no，並未給出「沒有固定不變的編譯目標」這個理由——後者是本文自己的推測，行文中須標記。

notes.quote: After enough failed attempts, LuaJIT blacklists empty_fn's bytecode, so the hot loop calling it can no longer be JIT-compiled and falls back to the interpreter, even though the loop itself never touches pcall or unpack.
notes.interpretation: 黑名單因果方向的逐字依據：被列入黑名單的是 empty_fn 自己的 bytecode，因此「呼叫 empty_fn 的那個熱迴圈」才編譯不成 trace；不是 empty_fn 因為呼叫了別的被黑名單函式而被牽連。trace log 的 blacklisted at pcall_mre.lua:2 指的正是 empty_fn 的定義那一行。
